metadata.scope: translation-quality review only; no encode/controlfix/injection/runtime judgment

policy.script: kana-only: hiragana, katakana, supported Japanese symbols, ASCII; no kanji
policy.wakachigaki: Use word/bunsetsu spacing in normal prose. No internal spaces in menu items, proper nouns, Pokemon/move/item names, place names, or short UI labels.
policy.space_encoding: Half-width and full-width spaces both encode to Japanese-page 0x00.
policy.unsupported_symbols: 「」、： are not in the Japanese charmap; 、 is replaced by the codec with ASCII ','. Do not use them.
policy.difficulty: General difficulty = むずかしさ. Difficulty mode names go in 「」 in prose only once the displayed buffer name is confirmed and the brackets can be encoded.
policy.first_person: Do not add ぼく/おれ/わたし when the speaker is unknown.
policy.tokens: Never change buffer, placeholder, FE/FA/FB, or other control tokens.

unbound_proper_nouns.Pokémon Unbound: ポケモン アンバウンド

unified_terms.boulder puzzle: いわを おす なぞとき

follow_up_checks: tbl_menu_options_00001_419DD3 grows to ~12 bytes vs slot 11 and 7 glyphs; verify relocation and option-column width.
Previously relocated entries (battle 00011/00012/00017/00343, menu_pause Save/Option, scr_1F0F89C) changed size; re-allocate.
Verify controlfix does not leave leading spaces after line breaks and prefers breaking at wakachigaki spaces.
Verify mission tab widths for しんこうちゅう and ミッション.
